_schema_note: retention/irrelevance cases run through ChatService.handle_query with explicit history (live LLM call, measures whether the model actually uses injected memory). session_boundary/cross_session_leakage cases exercise app.services.session_store.InMemorySessionStore / app.services.agent_memory.AgentMemory directly (deterministic, no LLM call) — they test the store's isolation guarantee, not generation quality.

session_boundary_cases.description: Only the last _MAX_HISTORY_TURNS (6, rag_service.py) turns should reach the prompt; a fact stated only in turn 1 of an 8-turn history should NOT be recalled by turn 9's query if it fell outside the window.
session_boundary_cases.measured_by: unit test against ChatService._inject_memory / history truncation, reusing backend/tests/test_memory_bounds.py's existing pattern

session_boundary_cases.description: Two distinct session_ids must not share history: a fact injected into session A's history must not be recoverable from a fresh query on session B.
session_boundary_cases.measured_by: app.services.session_store.InMemorySessionStore — create two sessions, add a turn to A, assert get_history(B) is empty/unaffected

cross_session_leakage_cases.description: A fact or PII-like value stored under tenant/session A must never be retrievable by a query issued under tenant/session B.
cross_session_leakage_cases.measured_by: app.services.agent_memory.AgentMemory — store a fact under session A, query build_context for session B, assert the fact is absent
cross_session_leakage_cases.note: desired result is exactly 0 leaked facts across all cross-session attempts in this case set; any leak is a hard fail, not a rate to average away
